WITH pharmacy_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    "customer_name" AS "Pharmacy Name", 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "invoice_date") AS "Month", 
    SUM("total_amount") AS "Total Sales"
  FROM "master_sale" 
  WHERE "customer_type" = 'Pharmacies' 
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
golm_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    "Pharmacy Name", 
    "Month", 
    "Total Sales", 
    LAG("Total Sales") OVER (PARTITION BY "Pharmacy Name" ORDER BY "Month") AS "Prev Month Sales",
    ("Total Sales" - LAG("Total Sales") OVER (PARTITION BY "Pharmacy Name" ORDER BY "Month")) / NULLIF(LAG("Total Sales") OVER (PARTITION BY "Pharmacy Name" ORDER BY "Month"), 0) * 100 AS "GOLM%"
  FROM pharmacy_sales
)
SELECT 
  "Pharmacy Name", 
  "GOLM%"
FROM golm_calc
WHERE "GOLM%" < 0
ORDER BY "GOLM%" ASC
LIMIT 5;

WITH area_wise_growth AS (
  SELECT 
    area_name, 
    SUM(total_amount) AS total_amount, 
    LAG(SUM(total_amount)) OVER (ORDER BY year_number, month_number) AS prev_month_amount
  FROM master_sale 
  GROUP BY year_number, month_number, area_name
)
SELECT 
  area_name, 
  (total_amount - prev_month_amount) / NULLIF(prev_month_amount, 0) * 100 AS mom_growth
FROM area_wise_growth 
WHERE prev_month_amount IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY mom_growth DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH Internal AS (
  SELECT ib."name", SUM(ms."product_quantity") as qty 
  FROM "master_sale" ms 
  JOIN "customer_details" cd ON ms."customer_id" = cd."customer_id" 
  JOIN "ims_brick" ib ON cd."ims_brick_id" = ib."id" 
  WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ms."invoice_date") = 12

),
Market AS (
  SELECT ib."name", SUM("unit") as qty 
  FROM "ims_sale" s
